note: Right-click menu wins reliably — and shows only one clipboard glyph. The compose IIFE binds oncontextmenu on DOMContentLoaded which fires AFTER the snapshot scripts synchronous bind, so the compose handler was overwriting the snapshot menu. Switched to addEventListener in capture phase plus stopImmediatePropagation so the snapshot menu always fires and the compose oncontextmenu does not stack on top. Single clipboard emoji now — the icon span carries it, the text label is plain. Style indicator picker (RSI, Temperature, delta-T, IPS, plus any promoted) is always there below the snapshot, in every chart mode.
